issues.on_page: Statement of Cash Flows - Proprietary Funds, Total: operating 81,733; noncapital financing 3,673; capital and related financing (121,690); investing (58,276); cash beginning 406,345; end 311,785
issues.issue: The enterprise funds (accrual basis) print a full cash flow statement, but proprietary is null because the report basis is 'cash', following later years. This is defensible under the schema (proprietary is listed for GAAP), but printed figures are left out.

The Statement of Activities (p3) shows it as Water capital grants and contributions; the cash flow statement (p8) shows it as grant proceeds under capital financing. No grantor is printed, so other/Grants is defensible but it could be intergovernmental. This is a judgment call.
